request.prompt: Repaint the attached square watercolor landscape as a new native high-resolution wide illustration, 3840x2160 pixels. This is a complete new rendering, not a blurry enlargement or stretched square. Wide 16:9 landscape, composed for a desktop display. Keep airy light sky and cloud-filled valley across the upper and middle two thirds; flowers grow from the bottom corners and lower fifth, with a few small blooms near bottom center. Keep the dark jade website text area pale and uncluttered. Full-bleed opaque painting, no people, no text, no lettering, no UI, no logo, no frame, no watermark, no sun disc, no 3D or photography. A pink cosmos morning meadow floating above a sea of clouds. Dominant flower colors are rose pink, fuchsia and blush, with muted raspberry stamens, sage green stems and just a few tiny ivory accents. Upper sky is pale rose-tinted cool pearl and mist blue. Pink light grazes the cloud rims. A soft breeze gives cosmos petals an airy, joyful feeling. Predominantly pink flowers, not mixed multicolor flowers. Tender transparent pigments and a light open sky distinguish this scene.
